screens.name: Iniciar Sesión (Login)
screens.reachedVia: Entry point of the app. Root '/' and unauthenticated GET on any protected .aspx (MiCuenta.aspx, Estado.aspx, Rastreo.aspx, PruebaExportacion.aspx, PreAlerta.aspx, PagoOnline.aspx) all redirect here when there is no valid session. The visible 'Entrar' button (an <a onclick="login()">) triggers the login form, which POSTs to Login.aspx.
screens.notes: Root '/' renders the same login markup directly (no redirect observed) under the page title 'Domipack - Web Trans'.

methodologyNotes: Evidence-based discovery only: every entry above was reached via an observed link, menu item, form action, or redirect in this session — no route was guessed by pattern.
Unauthenticated access was directly verified (real navigation, observed redirect to Login.aspx) for: MiCuenta.aspx, Estado.aspx, Rastreo.aspx, PruebaExportacion.aspx, PreAlerta.aspx, PagoOnline.aspx.

Session-behavior finding: navigating back to Login.aspx (or presumably NuevaCuenta.aspx) AFTER authenticating appears to silently invalidate the session — all subsequent requests are redirected to Login.aspx again, even though the ASP.NET_SessionId cookie is unchanged. Worth carrying into the functional-findings phase.

A fresh Playwright page (new tab) in the same authenticated browser context, opened after login, was redirected to Login.aspx even with the session cookie present — suggesting some client-side session/tab-scoped state is also involved, not only the server session cookie. Also worth carrying into findings.

Login has an observed variable-length delay (roughly 4-20 seconds) between submitting credentials and the redirect to Rastreo.aspx, with an intermediate document.title of 'Loading https://.../Rastreo.aspx'.
